verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack never documents a scheduler, timer trigger, or recurring workflow feature. The CLI, REST API and IaC evidence covers one-off scripted or declarative actions, not a recurring schedule. Running those scripts from an external cron would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The single Azure Functions mention is a complaint about logs and says nothing about scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
